value.rationale: A natural infinite graph-product family admits a complete all-weight combinatorial census controlled by base-set neighborhoods, with strict edge monotonicity, sharp extremal graph characterizations, and a nontrivial Pell–Lucas sunlet formula. Unlike the known scalar optimum, this captures multiplicities at every weight and quantitatively links graph density to minimal-function counts.
